posts.name: noname19
posts.cooked:
after the post about the idea of replacing libreoffice and how some users would like to have the fedora installation without any office suite, i was thinking on how different is everyone’s use of their pc

i personally use very little programs on my daily driver

i use firefox but im thinking on moving to librewolf, to use youtube, mail, whatsapp and read news

i use vlc when i want to play some video files i have locally

i use librefofice , writer in particular to write letters and documents

i use kcalc when i need to make some numbers for cost of builds, stuff i have to pay

jdownloader when i have to download some large file that needs something more capable than just the web browser

document scanner to scan some images or documents a couple times per month

gimp for some occasional project editing a image(gimp is not a easy tool to use to be honest, looking for a replacement)

xnview mp to look at images, it also can interface with the scanner and capture images directly

spectacle, i often share screen captures of things i am looking at with friends

some of the programs i have, i use them perhaps each month or two, only firefox sees daily use

posts.name: FranciscoD
posts.cooked:
I mostly only use a few things:

  • ptyxis with byobu for multiple sessions
  • taskwarrior + timewarrior for task/time tracking
  • vim with plugins for all editing (code, journaling in LaTeX etc.)
  • neomutt +offlineimap + msmtp for email
  • weechat for irc/slack
  • qutebrowser for browsing
  • gnome-pomodoro + extension
  • evolution for calendar (tried gnome-calendar, but returned to evolution)
  • newsboat for rss feed reading
  • dejadup runs for backups from time to time
  • syncthing for syncing between different machines
  • pass for password management
  • rarely use libreoffice etc—mostly only for work that require use of docs/spreadsheets, and even then sometimes they use docx etc., so i need to use a windows machine if the online office bit doesnt work
  • zathura for pdf reading
  • vimiv for images (vimlike)
  • last few months: opencode for assisting with development etc related tasks

Most of my work is done in different byobu profiles in the terminal.

Edit: turns out it’s quite a few things, not only a few things..
